skill.name: ecommerce-product-research
skill.description: Research ecommerce product candidates from supplied information or SocialDataX queries for Douyin and Xiaohongshu, with visible prices, selection reasons, and verification gaps.
skill.summary: Build traceable product shortlists from supplied data or supported online queries.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Of 42 static findings, 41 are false positives involving Markdown, documented credentials, service links, product identifiers, or readable Chinese text. One command-block finding is confirmed because its examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic installation approval. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or concealed payloads in the reviewed files; external package behavior was not assessed.

remediation.issue: Online query examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y, allowing package changes and suppressing the installation prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version, verify package provenance, and require explicit user approval before installation or execution.

content.value_statement: Product information is often incomplete and difficult to compare consistently. This skill organizes supplied data or supported online results into traceable shortlists with prices, selection reasons, and verification gaps.
actual_capabilities: Analyze supplied product tables or text without requiring an API key.
Guide Douyin and Xiaohongshu product searches and detail lookups through documented SocialDataX CLI commands or corresponding MCP tools.
Apply supported Douyin price, sorting, store, and service filters; screen Xiaohongshu results using visible prices.
Start with one result page, present up to five candidates, and verify details for two or three relevant products.
Produce Markdown shortlists with product sources, visible prices, matching criteria, selection reasons, and missing information.
Handle partial responses using returned pagination tokens while retaining existing results and retrieval limits.
limitations: Online queries support only Douyin and Xiaohongshu and require a SocialDataX API key and service availability.
Direct CLI queries require Node.js/npm and execute an external npm package; the supplied examples use an unpinned version.
Candidate samples do not establish market size, verified sales, growth rates, market share, or future product success.
Profit estimates require supplied costs and fees; unsupported-platform links require pasted product information.

use_cases.title: Screen products for a small store
use_cases.description: Compare Douyin candidates against a budget and requested service conditions, then identify products needing detail verification.

use_cases.title: Review an existing supplier list
use_cases.description: Organize supplied product information into a shortlist without online queries, while marking missing specifications, prices, and costs.

use_cases.title: Compare products for an audience
use_cases.description: Review Xiaohongshu candidates against audience needs and visible pricing, with sources and clear limits on market conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare supplied products
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these supplied products for [audience]: [product information]. Use only this information and mark missing prices, specifications, and sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: analyze existing information without online access.

prompt_templates.title: Find a focused shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Douyin [category] under [budget] yuan. Start with one page, list up to five candidates, and verify two relevant products.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use configured online access for a bounded product search.

prompt_templates.title: Compare platform evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [category] on Douyin and Xiaohongshu for [audience]. Use one page per platform, supported filters, visible prices, and traceable sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare small samples without implying market-wide coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Resume incomplete research
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this partial query result: [result]. Preserve retrieved items, identify the returned continuation token, and propose recovery within the original limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess interrupted retrieval without duplicating completed work.

output_examples.input: Compare supplied commuter bottles: Bottle A costs 79 yuan and holds 500 ml; Bottle B costs 119 yuan. Budget: 100 yuan.
output: Bottle A: 79 yuan; 500 ml; meets the stated budget; retain for review.
Bottle B: 119 yuan; exceeds the budget; exclude from the shortlist.
Sources: supplied information only. Store details, service terms, and observation time were not provided.

output_examples.input: Assess a supplied Xiaohongshu search excerpt: Organizer A costs 39 yuan; Organizer B has no returned price. Budget: 50 yuan.
output: Organizer A: visible price 39 yuan; meets the budget condition; dimensions and source identifier require verification.
Organizer B: price not returned; budget fit cannot be confirmed.
This comparison uses only the supplied excerpt. It does not establish platform-wide pricing, sales performance, or profitability.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, category, budget, and available product information before requesting online research.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and configure the API key securely outside prompts and generated reports.
Keep source links or identifiers, observation times, and missing-field labels with every candidate assessment.
anti_patterns: Treating search position or a small candidate sample as proof of platform-wide sales rankings.
Inventing prices, specifications, reviews, or profit estimates when supporting data is unavailable.
Repeating failed queries or expanding pagination automatically beyond the agreed retrieval limits.

faq.question: Can I use this skill without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Supplied product tables and text can be analyzed directly. Only online SocialDataX queries require an API key.

faq.question: Which platforms support online queries?
faq.answer: Douyin and Xiaohongshu. For other platforms, provide product information directly instead of relying on unsupported links.

faq.question: What is required for direct CLI queries?
faq.answer: Node.js/npm, network access, a configured SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, and sufficient service balance are required. Review and pin the external CLI package before execution.

faq.question: Does the skill modify my account or contact sellers?
faq.answer: The documented workflow performs product research only. It does not log in, post, contact sellers, or modify products or accounts.

faq.question: Can it predict sales or calculate profit?
faq.answer: It does not infer real sales, market share, or product success. Profit calculations require costs and fees supplied by you.

faq.question: What happens if a query fails or returns partial data?
faq.answer: The workflow preserves partial results, reports errors, and resumes with returned pagination tokens when available. Insufficient-balance errors should not trigger repeated retries.
